'''Sweet berry mash''' is the simple preparation of [[Sweet Berries|sweet berries]]. It heals {{Value|Sweet Berry Mash|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Health Boost}} for {{Value|Sweet Berry Mash|duration|effect=Health Boost}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/sweet_berry_mash.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Sweet berries cook into sweet berry mash in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in {{Value|Sweet Berry Mash|cook_time}}. Picking up sweet berries unlocks the oven recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating sweet berry mash takes {{Value|Sweet Berry Mash|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Sweet Berry Mash|heals}} and gives Health Boost {{Value|Sweet Berry Mash|level|effect=Health Boost}} (+2 hearts of maximum health) for {{Value|Sweet Berry Mash|duration|effect=Health Boost|format=clock}}.

Obtaining sweet berry mash unlocks [[Sweet Berry Jam|sweet berry jam]] and the [[Sweet Berry Danish|sweet berry Danish]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
